metadata.title: शिकार ना मिला तो आदिवासी लड़के ने क्या किया । What Hill Korwa Tribals eat । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
The Hill Korwa tribe is one of the 75 PVTGs of India. This tribe still follows the hunter gatherer lifestyle, in Jungles. The government has many special schemes for this tribe, but very little seems to have been achieved with regards to bringing them into the mainstream.
In this episode, we take you to a village in the Jungles of Korba district in Chhattisgarh state of India. Here, we will understand how they gather food from the Jungles around them.

Anchor - Shyam Sunder
